# Arithmetic Operators

Tests for arithmetic binary operators.

## Addition

### number plus number

> Adding two numbers produces a number.

```ds
const x = 1 + 2
```

### string plus string

> Concatenating two strings produces a string.

```ds
const x = "hello" + " world"
```

## Subtraction

### number minus number

> Subtracting two numbers produces a number.

```ds
const x = 5 - 3
```

## Multiplication

### number times number

> Multiplying two numbers produces a number.

```ds
const x = 2 * 3
```

## Division

### number divided by number

> Dividing two numbers produces a number.

```ds
const x = 10 / 2
```
